name: infra
description: Terraform Azure infrastructure for the Minions Agent Framework.

scripts.validate: cd terraform && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate
scripts.test: cd terraform && if ! command -v terraform >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'terraform not installed: skipping infra terraform tests (CI runs them in the dedicated terraform job)'; exit 0; fi; terraform init -backend=false && sh -c 'terraform test' --
